comparison.objective: Candidate screens finishing media from metal washers; PR places a phone, watch, and earbuds case on their matching charging locations.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests controlled pouring and orientation-dependent granular separation; PR tests multi-object pose alignment to charging contacts, watch-strap handling, and stand stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% recovered media, retained washers, no spill/damage, and released 3 s support dwell; PR requires all three devices visibly charging without support for 5 s while the stand stays within 5 mm and 5°.
comparison.reason: Selective passage through a screen tests a different physical ability from aligning consumer devices to charging interfaces; no missing numeric detail creates plausible duplication.
